item.title: Re: Knock Box (Seeking Greenlighting)
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi there XR Titan. Let’s take a look at your concept.

So I’m mainly confused: what do a black box, pulling items out of it Doraemon-style, video games and a heart attack have to do in common? The concept sounds like a mish-mash of different ideas in order for you to make it sound as cool as possible. When looked at as a whole, however, do you not see how the concept doesn’t have a central theme, message or even effect?

Ideally, you would want to choose one or two main anomalous effects and stick with them, explain them and derive a story from them. If opening a black box causes a heart attack, for example, cool. Why? What causes this upon opening it? Could it be related to what the user finds or sees on the inside? Likewise, if the opening a black box gives you items, cool. What kind of items? Are they related to the user’s childhood memories, e.g.? You see where I’m going with this? Any effect you introduce to the concept should be thematically linked in some way.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll try my best to reply again. All the best!

item.title: Knock Box (Seeking Greenlighting)
item.content:encoded:
The premise is pretty simple as it is a black box that when a user hears said knocking they are tempted to open it but they end up dead.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlighting: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mysterious

Page Layout: Standard Format

Elevator Pitch: Imagine if you take a walk in the forest silent and you see a random black box just sitting there you feel no attraction to it until you hear it knock twice, your suddenly now just have to look at that box you don't know why you have to always look at it. Again the box knocks and this time you go to open the box, you glee with excitement and you open it, a light shines through like a video game chest and… you die of a heart attack.

Central Narrative: The black Box is a simple looking box or crate with a unknown brand stuck on the top, bottom, and sides of the box that are advertising it. After random increments of time the box begins knocking at the first knock the subject just simply examines the box, but after the 3rd knock subject decides to open the box any attempts to stop said subject has failed. subject that are going to open the box seem to not be affected by any sort of damage until heart attack occurs. Subjects indeed take physical damage but some how do not die until said heart attack. when subjects open the box or are about to there heart rate begins to rise and facial expressions begin to show extreme excitement before open the box which there is a small chance that the pull something out the box which at that point should be contained in a simple opaque bag. as soon as subject dies said box will close. upon opening the box will show a bright light will glitter inside the box, the amount of objects in the box is unknown. objects inside the box seem to be quite simple man made objects of again unknown brand these objects include: pencils, blankets, coffee cups with coffee, etc. Each test of every subject pulls out a different object. it is presumed that the objects are what the subject wants or craves for.

Hook/Attention Grabber: The box is sure from its look it looks like a ordinary box but no matter the cause if someone hears that knock more than 6 times they always will get through what ever is in the way, the same effect happens with animals as well.

Additional Notes: None as of 12/3/2020
